Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Trainee position at Detergents Europe. With a background in digital marketing, web design, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your communications plan and support the voice of the cleaning and hygiene products industry in Europe.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with CMS platforms, social media integration, and analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console. My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to design and optimize a website for both traditional and AI-powered search engines, which aligns with your interest in emerging digital tools.

I am proactive, organized, and eager to learn. I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am prepared to work in Brussels. I am fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Trainee position at Detergents Europe. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content management, I am drawn to the opportunity to support the communications of an industry that plays a vital role in health and hygiene across Europe.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content writing, and WordPress site building and maintenance. I am comfortable using CMS platforms like WordPress, design tools like Canva, and analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console. My work involves tracking performance and using data to improve reach and engagement, which aligns with your need for monitoring and reporting on digital communications.

My personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates my ability to manage a full-cycle website project, from design and content to technical SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). I implemented structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines, reflecting my interest in emerging communications tools and AI-powered technologies.

I am proactive, organized, and detail-oriented, with a project management mindset. I am used to working independently and as part of a team, and I thrive under time pressure. I am fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, and I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, ready to work in Brussels.

I am eager to bring my skills to Detergents Europe and contribute to creative and impactful projects. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing this opportunity further.
